author: rezbla
body:
Hi, I'm Rezbla. Many of you may remember me becuase I played a lot of on this server and trying to help out, but I was banned around a year ago for a punishment that I did not commit of my own accord. I was banned because my friend Cezbla, went on my account and started making DDOS Threats to any and all players. (if you do not believe me I do understand, I would just like to tell you that all words I am saying now are the truth.). I am sorry for my friends actions, but I would like to get back into nebula and helping the community. I also had an Emerald rank, just to show you that I did support this server. Thank you for taking your time to read this. 

-Rezbla

title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: Atheyna
replies.body:
Hi Rezbla,

Apologies for the late response. Due to the amount of time you have remained banned, we have decided to appeal you. We however, expect you to follow ALL of our rules that we have (ensure that you review the new rules please)

Regards,
Arigenn, Administrator
